meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.10;
father of: Jedaiah (H3042H)
§ Harumaph = "split nose"
father of Jedaiah, one of the builders of the wall in Nehemiah's time

elsewhere.note: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
